title: When was your last dental check-up?
text: Once a year keeps your bonus booklet full. In Germany, a yearly stamp in your bonus booklet (Bonusheft) means a bigger subsidy for dental work later. Livo reminds you every year – you just make the call. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

title: Car insurance in Germany? Switch by 30 Nov.
text: Miss it and you're often tied in for another year. Most German car insurance policies run until 31 December – you have to cancel by 30 November. With Livo you won't miss the window. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

title: Forgot your TÜV? That can get expensive.
text: In Germany, there's a fine once you're 2 months overdue. The TÜV inspection is due every 2 years, for new cars first after 3 years. Add the month from your sticker to Livo – Livo reminds you in time. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.
